lead: A block of content set apart from the text around it: a message in a conversation (the customer's, the agent's, an internal note), a suggested reply, a quotation. `variant` and `color` set the look; the content is anything. For a short status message with an icon and a title, see [Alert](/alert); for a titled panel, [Card](/card).

usage.title: Usage
usage.content: Anything goes inside: text, a heading and a list, a form.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `outline` a border, `soft` a tinted background, `dashed` a dashed border on a light tint.

conversation.title: A conversation
conversation.description: What it was made for: a message of each kind, told apart by `variant` and `color`.
conversation.customerText: How do I invite a teammate with read-only access?
conversation.agentText: Open Settings, then Members, and pick the Viewer role.
conversation.noteText: The customer has asked twice, can you look at this one?

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `callout.css`: the tint is `color-mix` of the colour's token, the border is `--ui-border`.
styling.variants: Theme styles pick the look with them; `data-radius` appears only when `radius` is passed
